title: 第19章 格温第20章 刀锋
content_zh:
第19章格温
“好。”
詹姆森急忙将公文袋递给安德鲁，安德鲁点了点头，起身离开办公室，外面的人见到他，纷纷恭敬的喊道：“王先生。”
只有彼得没有开口，因为他一见到安德鲁，全身细胞都在提醒他对方非常危险，让他赶快逃跑。
“下午茶我的。”
安德鲁笑了笑，特意看了彼得一眼，彼得差点没吓得从楼上跳下去，安德鲁哑然失笑，蜘蛛感应很灵敏嘛，他摇了摇头，离开报社。
安德鲁离开后，彼得大大松了一口气，刚刚他吓得全身寒毛都立起来了，他朝一旁的秘书问道：“刚刚那位是谁？感觉好气派。”
“是我们的大老板，重生集团董事长安德鲁·王先生。”
秘书一脸懊悔地说道：“早知道王先生要来，我就去做个头发，换件好衣服了，他可是曼哈顿第一钻石男，不仅身家数百亿，还是个年轻的大帅哥。”
彼得无语，他看了一眼对方无名指上的结婚戒指，识相的保持沉默。
彼得暗暗想道：“王先生为什么会给我这么大的压力？难不成他是什么外星人？”
……
曼哈顿克林顿区，因为杂乱落后的居住品质、严重的族群冲突与高犯罪率，被纽約人称作地狱厨房。
这天晚上，安德鲁穿着t恤和牛仔裤，来到地狱厨房一家酒吧喝酒——这家酒吧有浓重的鲜血气息，如果没猜错，应该是吸血鬼的一个据点。
没过多久，两个浓妆艳抹的美女主动靠到安德鲁身边，问道：“帅哥，能不能请我们喝杯酒？”
“这么快？我这魔王长得是不是太人畜无害了？”
安德鲁暗暗吐槽，他一眼就看出这两个美女不是人，他笑道：“求之不得。”
两个美女一左一右坐在安德鲁身边，主动送豆腐给他吃，等安德鲁被迷的‘五迷三道’，其中一个绿头发的美女说道：“帅哥，想不想去一个更刺激的地方？”
安德鲁装模作样地问道：“比你们还刺激？”
“比我们刺激一百倍，在那里，你会见到以前从未见过的事。”

另一个美女说道：“我保证你终身难忘。”
“都死了，自然终生难忘。”
安德鲁吐槽，这两个吸血鬼美女，应该是专门带食物去‘吸血鬼餐厅’的托。
安德鲁正要答应，旁边传来一个充满兴趣的声音：“刺激的地方？我们能一起去吗？”
“还有人赶着去送死？”
安德鲁有点好奇，转头朝声音来的方向看去，发现是一个年纪不大的金发男。
“你们好。”
见安德鲁等人看过来，金发男打了声招呼，接着，他指着身后的伙伴介绍道：“我们是纽約大学的学生，今天是我生日，他们来帮我庆祝生日。”
安德鲁问道：“来地狱厨房庆祝生日？”
金发男说道：“我想找点刺激的地方，不过，地狱厨房的酒吧和其他地方好像没什么不同。”
content_en:
Chapter 19 Gwen
"Okay."
Jameson hurriedly handed the briefcase to Andrew. Andrew nodded, stood up and left the office. When people outside saw him, they shouted respectfully: "Mr. Wang."
Only Peter did not speak, because as soon as he saw Andrew, all the cells in his body reminded him that the other party was very dangerous, telling him to run away quickly.
"Afternoon tea is mine."
Andrew smiled and looked at Peter specifically. Peter almost jumped off the building in fear. Andrew laughed dumbly. His spider sense was very sensitive. He shook his head and left the newspaper office.
After Andrew left, Peter breathed a sigh of relief. He was so frightened that the hairs all over his body stood up. He asked the secretary on the side: "Who was that just now? It feels so grand."
"It's our big boss, Mr. Andrew Wang, chairman of Rebirth Group."
The secretary said with regret: "If I had known that Mr. Wang was coming, I would have had my hair done and changed into better clothes. He is the number one diamond man in Manhattan. Not only is he worth tens of billions, he is also a handsome young man."
Peter was speechless. He glanced at the wedding ring on the other person's ring finger and remained silent knowingly.
Peter secretly thought: "Why does Mr. Wang put so much pressure on me? Could it be that he is some kind of alien?"
…
The Clinton District of Manhattan is called Hell's Kitchen by New Yorkers because of its messy and backward living quality, serious ethnic conflicts and high crime rate.
That night, Andrew wore a T-shirt and jeans and went to a bar in Hell's Kitchen to drink - this bar had a strong smell of blood, and if he guessed correctly, it should be a stronghold of vampires.
Not long after, two beauties with heavy makeup approached Andrew and asked, "Handsome guy, can you buy us a drink?"
"So fast? Do I, the devil, look too harmless?"
Andrew secretly complained. He could tell at a glance that these two beauties were not human beings. He smiled and said, "It's what I asked for."
Two beauties sat next to Andrew, one on the left and the other on the right, offering him tofu to eat. When Andrew was fascinated, one of the green-haired beauties said, "Handsome, do you want to go to a more exciting place?"
Andrew pretended to ask: "More exciting than you?"
“It’s a hundred times more exciting than us, where you’ll see things you’ve never seen before.”
Another beauty said: "I guarantee you will never forget it."
"They are all dead, and of course they will never be forgotten for the rest of their lives."
Andrew complained that these two vampire beauties should be the ones who bring food to the 'Vampire Restaurant'.
Andrew was about to agree when an interested voice came from beside him: "An exciting place? Can we go together?"
"Is there anyone still rushing to die?"
Andrew was a little curious, turned his head and looked in the direction of the sound, and found that it was a young blond man.
"Hello."
Seeing Andrew and others looking over, the blond man said hello, and then pointed to his friends behind him and introduced: "We are students from New York University. Today is my birthday. They are here to help me celebrate my birthday."
Andrew asked, "Coming to Hell's Kitchen to celebrate your birthday?"
The blond man said: "I want to find something exciting, but the bar in Hell's Kitchen seems to be no different from other places."
